notes: 1922 four-storey narrow flats, 6.8 m front. Light grey-cream stucco, an arched wood entry with a stone surround at the right of the ground floor and barred doors and a window at the left, a balcony on the second storey spanning the front, a flat window row above and a fire escape on the right. Plain, no ornament invented. Tint lift (2026-10-02): paint tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k); brick tints converted to target / kit colour. Light grey upper wall d4d0c6 over a separate beige ground band; continuous iron-railed balcony across the first floor; arched double door now dark stained wood. Fire escape on the right half kept. Lifted/converted once to #eae8e2. GroundBand lift (2026-10-03): groundBand tint #cdb98c -> #e6dcc6 (same rule as walls; it was missed by the first colour pass).
